messages:
sarah: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/8425 is ready but it's blocked by an architecture decision. The behavior around routing fallback vs model variant selection isn't fully specified in the RFC. Can an architecture lead take a look?

jacob: pinging @maria-arch and @ravi-pm for visibility. RFC is here: https://rdrw.internal/rfcs/542

maria-arch: I can take a look. initial skim: big-picture makes sense, but we need explicit failover priority (region -> tier -> model-variant) documented, and a short note on how this interacts with Dedicated pools.

sarah: thanks. I'll add a short section clarifying failover order and the Dedicated pool behavior. PR is gated on the RFC update — currently blocked from merge.
ravi-pm: what's the customer impact window? we have a canary scheduled next week for the feature.
jacob: if arch signoff arrives by end of day Tuesday we can still include it in the Wed canary. otherwise we should delay.
maria-arch: I can do a deeper review tomorrow morning. if sarah adds the failover bullets + one perf datapoint, I can LGTM after that.
sarah: just pushed a commit with the bullets and a tiny perf table (latency and token cost differences). cc @maria-arch
maria-arch: quick nit: replace "fallback to small" with "fallback to cpu-optimized variant" for precision. otherwise looks good :+1:

sarah: updated the wording and squashed the perf table into the PR. requesting formal arch signoff.
arch-bot: RFC 542 updated: https://rdrw.internal/rfcs/542 — changelog entry added (failover order + dedicated pool section).
maya-release: heads-up — deployment ops needs the merge before 09:00 Wed PST to include in the canary. please aim for arch signoff by 20:00 Tue so we can coordinate.
maria-arch: arch signoff: LGTM from architecture after reading the updated RFC and PR comments. leaving a short note on the PR.
jacob: thanks everyone. sarah, please merge after arch LGTM and one more dev review. confirm CI green before merging.
sarah: I'll wait for the second dev review but plan to merge once CI is green. happy to hold to Wed morning if folks want.
ravi-pm: let's keep it Wed morning to reduce risk of last-minute rollbacks. thanks all.
thread_text_summary: PR 8425 blocked pending architecture review and RFC update (failover order + Dedicated pools). Maria to review; arch signoff needed by Tue EOD to make Wed canary; PR link and RFC link provided; CI + one dev review required before merge.
